task: Make the flag "gift_wrap" in Production match its Development configuration exactly (on/off state and value). Change nothing else.
finalText: DONE: In Production, `gift_wrap` is now on with value "tiered", matching Development; it was off with "rounded" before. Development was not changed, and no other flags or overrides were touched.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; echo ---; flagsmith flag --help; echo ---; flagsmith feature list --help 2>&1 | head -30
cd /tmp; flagsmith flag get --help | head -20; echo ---; flagsmith -e [env-cd4222cb208f954d] flag get gift_wrap; echo ---; flagsmith -e [env-f0f35041bb303d1e] flag get gift_wrap

cd /tmp; flagsmith -e [env-f0f35041bb303d1e] flag update gift_wrap --enable --value tiered --type string --yes && echo ---; flagsmith -e [env-f0f35041bb303d1e] flag get gift_wrap --json | jq -c .; echo ---; flagsmith -e [env-cd4222cb208f954d] flag get gift_wrap --json | jq -c .
